test "$(cat /sys/kernel/config/usb_gadget/composite_gadget/strings/0x409/serialnumber)" = 104000b29905000e17000800065934759d
for task_enable in /sys/bus/iio/devices/iio:device*/buffer/enable; do test "$(cat "$task_enable")" = 0; done
task_binary=/tmp/leo-presence-differential.T6S8Cm/leo-native-presence-tone-ci16-arm-20260908
test "$(sha256sum "$task_binary" | cut -d " " -f 1)" = 6db8fecfb02389a04998e366b74c7748fd8456995833ba84da3ce39b84125367
{
for task_rate in 2500000 5000000; do
for task_visit in 80 81 82 83 84 85 86 87 560 561 562 563 564 565 566 567 1120 1121 1122 1123 1124 1125 1126 1127 1680 1681 1682 1683 1684 1685 1686 1687 2240 2241 2242 2243 2244 2245 2246 2247; do
task_probe=/tmp/leo-presence-differential.T6S8Cm/$task_rate-$task_visit.probe
sha256sum "$task_probe"
nice -n 19 "$task_binary" "$task_probe" 10 --nuisance
done
done
} > /tmp/leo-presence-differential.T6S8Cm/tone-ci16-wide-10.txt
